title: Empty State CTA
requirements: Replace the passive "No entries yet. Click 'New Entry'…" text in EmptyState with a centered, prominent CTA Button labeled "New Entry" styled .borderedProminent that calls the same startRecording() action as the toolbar New Entry primary action — single source of truth for the action
acceptance_criteria: From a fresh installation, a user can start their first recording with one click of the centered CTA
The CTA and the toolbar button trigger the identical startRecording() action
The CTA is visually prominent (not a plain text link)
